Finish: Ruxton Ave at Manitou Ave

description: From Manitou Springs City Hall (6,300 ft) up Ruxton Avenue and Barr Trail: the Ws, No Name Creek, the runnable stretch to Barr Camp, above treeline at the A-Frame and up the Golden Stairs to the turnaround near the summit (about 14,050 ft), then back down the same trail to Ruxton Avenue. The Ascent is the first 13.32 miles. Most of the climb is steeper than the treadmill goes; the descent is flat without decline. Unofficial.

source.notes: The course unchanged since 1976: Manitou Springs up Barr Trail to the turnaround near the summit and back. Route traced over OpenStreetMap roads and Barr Trail; the course is uncertified and states 26.21 miles, so distances are scaled to the race's published aid-station mileages (No Name Creek, Barr Camp, A-Frame, the turnaround, and the same points on the way down). OpenStreetMap runs short above Barr Camp, where the switchbacks are tighter than it maps, so those sections are stretched about 7%. Elevations from USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar. Grades above your treadmill's maximum are capped, and the descent is flat without decline. The altitude, up to 14,050 ft, can't be simulated. Unofficial.
